name: io.github.WYRE-AI/webfleet-mcp
title: Webfleet
description: Read-only MCP server for Bridgestone Webfleet (WEBFLEET.connect) fleet telematics data.

environmentVariables.name: WEBFLEET_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: WEBFLEET.connect username (sent as HTTP Basic Auth)

environmentVariables.name: WEBFLEET_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: WEBFLEET.connect password (sent as HTTP Basic Auth)

environmentVariables.name: WEBFLEET_HOST
environmentVariables.description: WEBFLEET.connect API host. Optional. Defaults to csv.webfleet.com.

environmentVariables.name: WEBFLEET_LANG
environmentVariables.description: Response language code. Optional. Defaults to en.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode for the server. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.
